title: Make list-microphones binary interactive with microphone selection
description:
## Current State
The list-microphones binary currently just prints available microphones and exits with usage instructions.

## Desired Behavior
Make it interactive so users can:
1. See the list of available microphones (input devices)
2. Select one using arrow keys or number input
3. Have the selection automatically written to the systemd service file (~/.config/systemd/user/recording-daemon.service)

## Implementation Notes
- Focus on input devices, not monitor devices (loopbacks)
- Mark the currently configured microphone if one is set
- May need to reload systemd after writing the service file
- Consider using a TUI library like dialoguer or inquire for selection UI
close_reason: Implemented interactive microphone selection with dialoguer. Binary now allows arrow-key selection, updates systemd service file, and restarts the daemon.
